selection_rule.high_confidence: Among original held-out items accepted by Mizan and answered correctly by gpt-4o-mini, excluding religious subjects (Islamic Studies), the highest finite margin. An item with no competing option has no measured margin and is not eligible. Ties go to the lowest numeric item ID. The subject exclusion is a presentation choice and has no effect on any result.
selection_rule.lower_confidence: Among original held-out items escalated by Mizan where gpt-4o-mini is wrong and gpt-4.1 is right, the lowest finite margin. If no such item exists, the lowest finite margin among all escalated items, with no claim of correction. Ties go to the lowest numeric item ID.
